# স্বর্ণ সুতা (Shorno Suta)

> Shorno Suta is a Bangladesh-based online fashion store offering apparel with cash on delivery across the country.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured products and category showcase.
- [Shop](/shop): Browse the full product catalog.
- [Trending Products](/trending): Best-selling and trending items.
- [Clearance](/clearance): Discounted clearance items.
- [Cart](/cart): Shopping cart and checkout entry point.
- [About](/about): About Shorno Suta.
- [Contact](/contact): Customer support contact details.
- [Order Status](/order-status): Track your order.
- [Return & Exchange Policy](/Return-ExchangePolicy): Return and exchange terms.
- [Refund Policy](/refund-policy): Refund and cancellation terms.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): Privacy practices.
- [Policies](/policies): Combined store policies.

## Optional

- [Install App](/app): Install the customer mobile app (PWA).
